title: Dozens pepper NY officials with questions about highway plans for Micron growth in Clay
summary: Over 200 Clay residents attended a town hall to discuss highway infrastructure improvements needed to support Micron Technology's regional expansion. The meeting focused on transportation planning and capital infrastructure requirements driven by major economic development, signaling constituent engagement on infrastructure-related growth impacts.

political_signal.description: Large resident turnout (200+) at town hall indicates significant community engagement and concern regarding infrastructure capacity planning tied to major employer expansion; suggests need for transparency and stakeholder communication on highway/transportation impact mitigation.
